notes: P/NP grading not allowed for any major course (Prep or UD major), including internships and courses applied to the major from other departments. Substitutions in the major requirements permissible only by petition to the department chair and dean. At least 2.0 overall UC average in all upper-division major courses and all courses (Prep and UD) for the major. With the approval of each department chairperson, up to a total of 8 units may be applied simultaneously to both UD majors. Students wishing to pursue an Honors thesis should consult with Faculty Undergraduate Advisor and must take at least one ARTHI 186/187 seminar prior to beginning their honors thesis. Consultation with the Faculty Undergraduate Advisor is recommended when choosing upper-division courses.
